traits.name: curious
traits.reason: Lines are templated greetings with coordinates only; no concrete observations of tiles, nodes or shapes, though it does ask peers what they are building.

traits.name: distractible
traits.reason: No mid-line swerves or idea cards; lines are repetitive and focused, though it moves between peers fairly often.

traits.name: bold
traits.reason: Only short walks of a few tiles and small wood gives and gathering; no long trips or big builds visible.

traits.name: creative
traits.reason: No unusual builds, combinations or testable idea cards; behaviour is routine greeting, trading and gathering.
